# Contact & Support

Need help beyond this documentation? Use the channels below:

- **General inquiries**: Send email via [repuragent.uu@gmail.com](mailto:repuragent.uu@gmail.com).
- **Product roadmap & feature ideas**: Open a GitHub issue in the [public GitHub Repo](https://github.com/pharmbio/repuragent/issues).

The maintainers triage issues weekly; urgent blocking bugs can be escalated via email.
